Title: General availability: Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Hyperscale (Citus) new certifications

Body.Content:
You can now use Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Hyperscale (Citus) for workloads that require your database to be compliant with the following certifications.

  • AFM and DNB (Netherlands): The Dutch Authority for the Financial Markets (Autoriteit Financiële Markten, AFM) and the Central Bank of the Netherlands (De Nederlandsche Bank, DNB)
  • AMF and ACPR (France): The Financial Authority (Autorité des Marchés Financiers, AMF) and the Prudential Authority (Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution, ACPR)
  • FINMA (Switzerland): The Financial Market Supervisory Authority (Eidgenössische Finanzmarktaufsicht, FINMA)
  • FSA (Denmark): The Financial Supervisory Authority (Finanstilsynet), under the Ministry of Industry, Business, and Financial Affairs
  • NBB and FSMA (Belgium): The National Bank of Belgium (NBB) and the Financial Services and Markets Authority (FSMA)
  • KNF(Poland): The Polish Financial Supervision Authority (Komisja Nadzoru Finansowego, KNF)
